dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef001
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a one-step certificate, this projects its 63rd real-valued component, identified by the surrounding type as its modular-accuracy parameter.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For each restarted step, this value parameterizes the theorem-record from which the two scalar remainder witnesses are extracted.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef002
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a one-step certificate, this projects its 66th component, a LocalDef027 record concerning the current and next iterates, with modular accuracy given by D001.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Applying this projection to every restarted step produces the records whose fifth and sixth real components define the required backward and forward remainder sequences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef003
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed inductive type of complete runs in dimension n; its supplied constructor bundles matrices, vectors, infinite iterate and error sequences, arithmetic assumptions, one-step certificates, and remainder estimates.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The proposition is universally quantified over these bundled runs, so all constructor requirements restrict which data are covered.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef004
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's n by n real matrix A.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: A occurs in the normalized residual, the Frobenius condition factor, and every restarted one-step record.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef005
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's n by n real matrix Ainv.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Frobenius norm contributes to the condition factor used in lambda and the forward-error floor.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef006
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's right-hand-side vector b in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in every normalized residual error eta_i and in the restarted records.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef007
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the sequence of n-vectors called correctionHat, indexed by natural-number iteration.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The correction at i is part of the restarted one-step certificate that determines the selected scalar remainders.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef008
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's real dimension factor d.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in lambda = d uLow kappa_F and in the additive floors d uHigh and d uHigh kappa_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef009
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's sequence of computed residual vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The residual at i is part of the restarted one-step certificate from which the target remainders are selected.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef010
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's restart function, which assigns to each i a one-step certificate for A, Ainv, b, xExact, xHat_i, xHat_(i+1), the computed residual, and the computed correction.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the direct source of the per-index theorem records and hence of both existential remainder sequences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef011
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's real parameter uHigh.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters both additive floors and the second-order scale (uHigh + uLow)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef012
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's real parameter uLow.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It enters lambda and the second-order scale (uHigh + uLow)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef013
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's exact solution vector xExact in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines every relative forward error and is included in each restarted record.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef014
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the run's infinite sequence of approximate solution vectors xHat_i in R^n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The target bounds normalized residual and relative forward errors at every natural-number iterate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef015
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the fifth real component of a LocalDef027 record; according to its constructor ordering, this is the backward remainder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The backwardRemainder witness is required to equal this component of the restarted theorem-record at every i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef016
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the sixth real component of a LocalDef027 record; according to its constructor ordering, this is the forward remainder.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The forwardRemainder witness is required to equal this component of the restarted theorem-record at every i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef017
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the normalized residual eta(A,b,x) as ||b-Ax||_2 divided by ||A||_F ||x||_2 + ||b||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the backward-error quantity in the one-step recurrence and global geometric bound.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef018
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the backward additive floor as d uHigh.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is added in each normalized-residual recurrence and in the backward global envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef019
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the forward additive floor as d uHigh times ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is added in each relative-forward-error recurrence and in the forward global envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef020
dependency_coverage.meaning: For lambda, a floor f, parameters uHigh and uLow, a scalar remainder q, and an error sequence E, it asserts that some C >= 0 satisfies |q_i| <= C(uHigh+uLow)^2 for all i and E_m <= lambda^m E_0 + (f + C(uHigh+uLow)^2)/(1-lambda) for all m.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies separate global geometric-plus-floor bounds for the backward and forward error sequences, each with its own existential constant.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef021
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines lambda as d uLow times ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The explicit premise is 0 <= lambda < 1, and lambda is the contraction coefficient in both recurrences and both global bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef022
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the relative vector error between exact x and approximation xHat as ||xHat-x||_2 / ||x||_2.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is the forward-error quantity bounded at each iteration and in the global envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef023
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a scalar sequence q, it asserts the existence of C >= 0 such that |q_i| <= C(uHigh+uLow)^2 for every natural i.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is required explicitly for each selected remainder sequence and is also repeated inside each D020 envelope.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef024
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed inductive type of one-step computation certificates for fixed matrices, exact and consecutive approximate vectors, computed residual and correction, and precision parameters.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Each restart i has this type, and target-relevant components 63 and 66 are projected from it; its full mathematical content cannot be reconstructed because its constructor dossier is truncated.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef025
dependency_coverage.meaning: The run constructor requires n>0; matrices A and Ainv; vectors b and xExact; iterate, residual, correction, residual-error, and update-error sequences; positive uHigh and uLow with uHigh <= uLow; nonnegative d; b nonzero; inverse and exact-solution identities; n uHigh<1 and n uLow<1; residual and update rounding models; restart certificates; norm-comparison remainders; and uniform second-order bounds for those and the restarted theorem remainders.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: These are bundled restrictions on every quantified run. In particular, the target's chosen remainder sequences already have D023-style estimates in the run data, while the target additionally states recurrences and D020 envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef026
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines LocalDef026 n as the type of real matrices indexed by Fin n rows and Fin n columns.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes A and Ainv as n by n real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef027
dependency_coverage.meaning: An indexed theorem-record type for one transition from xCurrent to xNext, parameterized by A, Ainv, b, xExact, uHigh, modular accuracy, and d; its supplied constructor stores recurrence factors, coefficients, and scalar backward and forward remainders satisfying stated bounds.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The fifth and sixth real fields of these records are exactly the two target remainder sequences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef028
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines LocalDef028 n as Fin n -> Real, the type of real n-vectors.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All exact, approximate, residual, correction, and error vectors have dimension n.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef029
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines kappa_F(A,Ainv) = ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This exact Frobenius-norm product appears in lambda and in the forward additive floor; it is not a spectral-norm condition number.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef030
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines ||b-AxHat||_2 / (||A||_F ||xHat||_2 + ||b||_2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: D017 unfolds to this quantity, so the backward side controls normalized residuals.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef031
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the Euclidean norm of an n-vector x as sqrt(sum over i in Fin n of x_i^2).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all vector norms in residuals, relative errors, run assumptions, and auxiliary certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef032
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the precision-size condition n u < 1, with n cast to a real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The bundled run requires this condition for both uHigh and uLow, restricting admissible runs and making the corresponding gamma denominators positive.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef033
dependency_coverage.meaning: A constructor for one-step certificates whose visible portion packages a positive Krylov dimension, basis and Hessenberg data, Arnoldi and modified Gram-Schmidt relations, rounding-error estimates, residual conversion, a least-squares minimizer, correction formation, coefficient bounds, and lower-gain assumptions; the supplied type ends with ellipses.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Restarted certificates are produced through this construction, but the omitted tail prevents an exact account of every assumption leading to the modular-accuracy and theorem-record fields used by the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef034
dependency_coverage.meaning: Constructs a LocalDef027 record from nonnegative backward and forward factors, high-precision coefficients, and scalar remainders. The factors are at most modularAccuracy times kappa_F; the high coefficients are at most d and d kappa_F; and the next backward and forward errors satisfy the corresponding affine inequalities.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It identifies projected fields five and six as additive scalar remainder terms and supplies the local inequalities underlying the target's recurrences.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef035
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines gamma_n(u) = n u / (1 - n u), with n cast to a real.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It appears in the bundled residual and one-step rounding assumptions, constraining admissible runs but not appearing explicitly in the final displayed bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef036
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the norm of a square real matrix using Mathlib's Frobenius normed-ring instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives ||A||_F and ||Ainv||_F in the normalized residual and kappa_F.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef037
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts that multiplication by A on R^n is a bijective function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: This is a bundled admissibility condition on runs; it is not a separately quantified hypothesis in the target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef038
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines square-matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i = sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines residuals, inverse identities, the exact equation AxExact=b, and several run assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef039
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the residual vector r(A,b,x) = b - Ax.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its Euclidean norm is the numerator of the normalized residual eta_i.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef040
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines LocalDef040 m k as the type of real m by k matrices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies dimensions for the one-step Arnoldi, basis, Hessenberg, and least-squares data bundled inside restart certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef041
dependency_coverage.meaning: Forms an m by (k+1) matrix whose first column is phi times b and whose remaining columns are those of C.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates only in the internal one-step certificate machinery and has no direct occurrence in the final proposition.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef042
dependency_coverage.meaning: For a right-hand-side vector rhs and an m by k matrix C, it selects rhs when the Fin(k+1) index is zero and selects column q of C at successor index q+1.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses columnwise least-squares perturbation bounds inside the restarted certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef043
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts that y is a Euclidean least-squares minimizer for Ay approximately equal to b: ||b-Ay||_2 <= ||b-Az||_2 for every z.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It constrains the least-squares result inside each one-step certificate but does not occur directly in the target conclusion.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef044
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts the lower-gain inequality sigma ||x||_2 <= ||Ax||_2 for every x.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an internal nondegeneracy assumption in the one-step certificate.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef045
dependency_coverage.meaning: Asserts that some unit vector x satisfies ||Ax||_2 <= delta.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It can constrain internal one-step cases but has no direct occurrence in the displayed target.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef046
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the Frobenius norm of a rectangular real matrix using Mathlib's Frobenius normed additive-group instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It measures internal Arnoldi, basis, and perturbation matrices in restart certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef047
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines rectangular matrix-vector multiplication: (Ax)_i = sum_j A_ij x_j.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is used in least-squares, basis-image, and correction statements inside one-step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: LocalDef048
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines multiplication of an n by n matrix A with an n by k matrix B by (AB)_ij = sum_q A_iq B_qj.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses Arnoldi and image-basis relations inside restarted certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: And
dependency_coverage.meaning: Logical conjunction of two propositions.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It combines the lambda assumptions and all simultaneous witness equalities, remainder estimates, recurrences, and global bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Eq
dependency_coverage.meaning: Propositional equality.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It fixes each existential function extensionally to the corresponding restarted-record projection.

dependency_coverage.name: Exists
dependency_coverage.meaning: Existential quantification.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It introduces the two scalar remainder sequences and the constants occurring inside D020 and D023.

dependency_coverage.name: HAdd.hAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous addition operation supplied by an HAdd instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its resolved instances give natural-number successor i+1 and ordinary real addition in all displayed formulas.

dependency_coverage.name: HMul.hMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous multiplication operation supplied by an HMul instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its resolved real instance gives all scalar products in lambda, floors, recurrences, and bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LE.le
dependency_coverage.meaning: The less-than-or-equal relation supplied by an LE instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses nonnegativity and all upper bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: LT.lt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The strict-order relation supplied by an LT instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it expresses the strict contraction requirement lambda<1 and precision positivity inside runs.

dependency_coverage.name: Nat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes dimensions and the unbounded iteration variables i and m.

dependency_coverage.name: OfNat.ofNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets a natural-number literal in a type with the corresponding OfNat instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the real literals 0 and 1 and the natural increment 1.

dependency_coverage.name: One.toOfNat1
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral 1 from a type's One instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the upper contraction threshold the real number 1.

dependency_coverage.name: Real
dependency_coverage.meaning: The type of real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: All scalar errors, parameters, norms, constants, and remainder values are real.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary addition operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets sums in recurrence right-hand sides and second-order scales.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive-group structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Together with the real lattice, it supports scalar absolute value.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLE
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal order on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets every real nonnegativity and upper-bound assertion.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instLT
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets lambda<1 and positive real assumptions.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: The ordinary multiplication operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets products defining lambda, floors, powers, and constant-scaled bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instOne
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative identity 1 in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the threshold and denominator term 1-lambda.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive identity 0 in the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies all nonnegativity baselines.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.lattice
dependency_coverage.meaning: The lattice structure induced by the real order.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It participates in defining scalar absolute value as max(a,-a).

dependency_coverage.name: Zero.toOfNat0
dependency_coverage.meaning: Builds interpretation of the numeral 0 from a type's Zero instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the real zero in 0<=lambda and C>=0.

dependency_coverage.name: abs
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines absolute value in a lattice-ordered additive group as max(a,-a); on reals this is the usual |a|.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Only the magnitudes of the scalar remainder values enter the recurrences and second-order bounds.

dependency_coverage.name: instAddNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard addition operation on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets i+1 and other successor-index arithmetic.

dependency_coverage.name: instHAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a homogeneous Add operation into an HAdd operation with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes natural addition and real addition to their standard operations.

dependency_coverage.name: instHMul
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a homogeneous Mul operation into an HMul operation with the same input and output type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes all real scalar multiplication to ordinary multiplication.

dependency_coverage.name: instOfNatNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: Interprets each natural numeral n as the same natural number n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the natural literal 1 used in iteration successors.

dependency_coverage.name: DivInvMonoid.toDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts division from a division-inverse monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For real numbers it supports the quotients defining normalized residuals, relative errors, gamma_n, and global envelopes.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Fin n is the finite type of natural indices strictly below n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It indexes vector coordinates and matrix rows and columns, fixing all finite dimensions.

dependency_coverage.name: HDiv.hDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous division operation supplied by an HDiv instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: Its real instance gives ordinary real division in all error ratios and envelope denominators.

dependency_coverage.name: HPow.hPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous exponentiation operation supplied by an HPow instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets lambda^m and the square (uHigh+uLow)^2.

dependency_coverage.name: HSub.hSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: The heterogeneous subtraction operation supplied by an HSub instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives vector differences, residuals, and the real denominator 1-lambda.

dependency_coverage.name: Monoid.toNatPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides natural-number powers in a monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it interprets lambda^m and second powers.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines subtraction of functions pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes xHat-xExact and b-Ax vector differences coordinatewise.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instDivInvMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The division and inverse monoid structure of the reals, with totalized division.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides every real quotient; in Lean, division remains defined even at a zero denominator.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The multiplicative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It provides natural powers of real lambda and of uHigh+uLow.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines real subtraction by a-b = a+(-b).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets 1-lambda and scalar differences used in deeper definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: instHDiv
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a homogeneous Div operation into an HDiv operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes every real quotient to real division.

dependency_coverage.name: instHPow
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a Pow operation into an HPow operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes real natural powers to the monoid power operation.

dependency_coverage.name: instHSub
dependency_coverage.meaning: Converts a homogeneous Sub operation into an HSub operation.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It routes real and pointwise vector subtraction to their standard operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.fintype
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides the finite enumeration of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes all sums defining vector norms and matrix products finite sums over exactly n coordinates.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.sum
dependency_coverage.meaning: Sums a function over a finite set in an additive commutative monoid.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It forms sums of squares, matrix-vector products, matrix products, and internal dot products.

dependency_coverage.name: Finset.univ
dependency_coverage.meaning: The finite set containing every element of a finite type.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It makes the relevant sums range over all finite coordinates.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines a matrix over alpha as a function from row indices and column indices to alpha.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It underlies both square n by n matrices and rectangular internal matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Ne
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines a != b as the negation of a=b.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: The bundled run requires b != 0, which helps ensure the normalized-residual denominator is nonzero.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instAdd
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines addition of functions pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets addition of vectors and, through matrix instances, matrices in the run and one-step equations.

dependency_coverage.name: Pi.instZero
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines the zero function pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets the zero vector used in the condition b != 0 and related internal statements.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instAddCommMonoid
dependency_coverage.meaning: The additive commutative monoid structure of the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports finite real sums in norms and matrix operations.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.sqrt
dependency_coverage.meaning: The nonnegative real square-root function.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It turns each sum of coordinate squares into the Euclidean vector norm.

dependency_coverage.name: instLTNat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard strict order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses n>0 and positive internal Krylov dimensions in bundled certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.castSucc
dependency_coverage.meaning: Includes Fin n into Fin(n+1) without changing the underlying natural value.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It aligns basis columns with the corresponding initial columns of an enlarged basis inside one-step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.succ
dependency_coverage.meaning: Maps an index j in Fin n to the index with value j+1 in Fin(n+1).
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It addresses successor columns and subdiagonal Hessenberg entries inside one-step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.val
dependency_coverage.meaning: Projects the underlying natural number from an element of Fin n.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It connects bounded Krylov indices with natural-number work-sequence indices.

dependency_coverage.name: Function.Bijective
dependency_coverage.meaning: A function is bijective when it is both injective and surjective.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines the bundled requirement that multiplication by A is bijective.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.add
dependency_coverage.meaning: Defines matrix addition pointwise.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets matrix perturbation and Arnoldi-product equations inside one-step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.frobeniusNormedRing
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides square matrices with a normed-ring structure whose norm is the Frobenius matrix norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the square-matrix norms used in eta and kappa_F.

dependency_coverage.name: Max.max
dependency_coverage.meaning: The maximum operation supplied by a Max instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: For reals it is used in the definition |a| = max(a,-a).

dependency_coverage.name: Nat.cast
dependency_coverage.meaning: Casts a natural number into a type with a NatCast instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It interprets n as a real in n u and gamma_n(u).

dependency_coverage.name: Norm.norm
dependency_coverage.meaning: The norm operation supplied by a Norm instance.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It extracts the Euclidean and Frobenius norms used throughout the definitions.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedRing.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the norm structure from a normed ring.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes the Frobenius norm of square matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instMax
dependency_coverage.meaning: The usual maximum operation on real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the ordinary real absolute-value operation through max(a,-a).

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instNatCast
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard embedding of natural numbers into the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It gives the real value of n in precision-size conditions and gamma_n.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.instRCLike
dependency_coverage.meaning: The RCLike structure on the real numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supports Mathlib's Frobenius normed-ring construction for real matrices.

dependency_coverage.name: instDecidableEqFin
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides decidable equality for Fin n indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is an implementation requirement for the square-matrix Frobenius norm instance and does not change the mathematical statement.

dependency_coverage.name: instLENat
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard less-than-or-equal order on natural numbers.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It expresses bounded internal dimensions and index-order assumptions in one-step certificates.

dependency_coverage.name: Fin.cases
dependency_coverage.meaning: Eliminates an index of Fin(n+1) by separating index zero from successor indices.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It defines augmented-column constructions used inside one-step least-squares data.

dependency_coverage.name: Matrix.frobeniusNormedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: Provides rectangular real matrices with their Frobenius normed additive-group structure, constructed as an iterated l2 norm.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It supplies the rectangular Frobenius norms used in internal basis and perturbation estimates.

dependency_coverage.name: NormedAddCommGroup.toNorm
dependency_coverage.meaning: Extracts the norm structure from a normed additive commutative group.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It exposes the rectangular-matrix Frobenius norm.

dependency_coverage.name: Real.normedAddCommGroup
dependency_coverage.meaning: The standard normed additive commutative group structure on the reals.
dependency_coverage.effect_on_target: It is the scalar norm structure used to construct Euclidean and Frobenius norms.

binders: A bundled run in dimension n. Its data include n by n real matrices A and Ainv, vectors b and xExact in R^n, natural-number-indexed vectors xHat_i, residualHat_i, correctionHat_i, residualError_i, and updateError_i, real parameters uHigh, uLow, and d, and a restarted one-step certificate R_i for every natural i.
Two existential scalar sequences B,F : Nat -> Real, subsequently forced by equality to be the backward and forward remainder fields of the restarted records.
hypotheses: The bundled run requires n>0, b != 0, multiplication by A to be bijective, Ainv(Az)=z and A(Ainv z)=z for every z in R^n, and A xExact=b.
The bundled run requires 0<uHigh, 0<uLow, uHigh<=uLow, and 0<=d.
The bundled run requires n uHigh<1, n uLow<1, and gamma_n(uHigh)<=d uHigh, where gamma_n(u)=n u/(1-n u).
For every i, residualHat_i=b-A xHat_i+residualError_i, and for every coordinate j, |residualError_i,j| <= gamma_n(uHigh)(|b_j| + sum_k |A_jk| |xHat_i,k|).
For every i, xHat_(i+1)=xHat_i+correctionHat_i+updateError_i, and for every coordinate j, |updateError_i,j|<=uHigh |xHat_(i+1),j|.
For every i, R_i is a one-step certificate indexed by A, Ainv, b, xExact, xHat_i, xHat_(i+1), residualHat_i, correctionHat_i, uHigh, uLow, and d.

The run contains scalar sequences q and p satisfying ||xHat_i||_2 <= ||xHat_(i+1)||_2+|q_i| and ||xHat_(i+1)||_2 <= ||xExact||_2+|p_i| for all i, with each sequence uniformly bounded by a nonnegative constant times (uHigh+uLow)^2.
The run also bundles uniform second-order bounds for the backward and forward remainder fields selected from the records R_i.
With kappa_F=||Ainv||_F ||A||_F and lambda=d uLow kappa_F, the target additionally assumes 0<=lambda<1.
conclusions: There exist scalar sequences B and F such that, for every i, B_i is exactly the fifth real component of the LocalDef027 record projected from R_i, and F_i is exactly its sixth real component.
There exists C_B>=0 such that |B_i|<=C_B(uHigh+uLow)^2 for every i.
There exists C_F>=0 such that |F_i|<=C_F(uHigh+uLow)^2 for every i.
For every natural i, eta_(i+1) <= lambda eta_i + d uHigh + |B_i|, where eta_i=||b-A xHat_i||_2/(||A||_F ||xHat_i||_2+||b||_2).
For every natural i, e_(i+1) <= lambda e_i + d uHigh kappa_F + |F_i|, where e_i=||xHat_i-xExact||_2/||xExact||_2.
There exists C'_B>=0 such that |B_i|<=C'_B(uHigh+uLow)^2 for every i and eta_m <= lambda^m eta_0 + (d uHigh + C'_B(uHigh+uLow)^2)/(1-lambda) for every natural m.
There exists C'_F>=0 such that |F_i|<=C'_F(uHigh+uLow)^2 for every i and e_m <= lambda^m e_0 + (d uHigh kappa_F + C'_F(uHigh+uLow)^2)/(1-lambda) for every natural m.
The four constants C_B, C_F, C'_B, and C'_F are introduced by separate existential statements and need not be equal.
mathematical_definitions: R^n means Fin n -> Real, and an n by n matrix means Fin n -> Fin n -> Real.
For x in R^n, ||x||_2 = sqrt(sum_j x_j^2).
For a real matrix M, ||M||_F is its Frobenius norm.
lambda = d uLow kappa_F, the backward floor is d uHigh, and the forward floor is d uHigh kappa_F.
SecondOrder(q) means that some C>=0 satisfies |q_i|<=C(uHigh+uLow)^2 for all natural i.
Envelope(lambda,f,q,E) means that some C>=0 simultaneously satisfies |q_i|<=C(uHigh+uLow)^2 for all i and E_m<=lambda^m E_0+(f+C(uHigh+uLow)^2)/(1-lambda) for all m.
translation.proposition_plain_english: For every bundled positive-dimensional run satisfying its exact linear-system, inverse, precision, residual-rounding, update-rounding, restart-certificate, and auxiliary remainder assumptions, suppose lambda=d uLow ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F lies in [0,1). Select at every iteration the backward and forward scalar remainder fields of the theorem-record stored in the corresponding restarted one-step certificate. These selected sequences are uniformly bounded by constants times (uHigh+uLow)^2. The normalized residual and relative forward error obey, at every natural-number iteration, affine recurrences with common coefficient lambda, respective floors d uHigh and d uHigh ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F, and the absolute selected remainder. Moreover, each error sequence has a geometric initial-error bound plus its floor and a second-order remainder allowance divided by 1-lambda, using a separately existential nonnegative constant for each error sequence.

restrictions_and_vacuity_risks: The implication is vacuous for any run with lambda outside [0,1), because 0<=lambda<1 is an explicit premise.

The proposition does not assert that a run exists for every n or every linear system. Quantification is only over already constructed LocalDef003 values, whose constructor requires n>0 and many additional certificates.
All iteration quantifiers range over every natural number; there is no finite stopping index or restriction i<n.
The condition factor is exactly the product of Frobenius norms ||Ainv||_F ||A||_F, not a spectral-norm condition number.

The formal second-order statements are fixed-run existential constant bounds. They do not quantify over a limiting process uHigh,uLow -> 0 and therefore are not, by themselves, an asymptotic big-O statement uniform across runs or precisions.
The constants in the standalone D023 bounds and those in the D020 envelopes are independent existential witnesses; the proposition does not require a common constant.
The remainder witnesses are not freely chosen: their function equalities uniquely fix every value to a component of the corresponding restarted theorem-record.
Only absolute values of scalar remainders occur; no sign, cancellation, or componentwise vector remainder information is concluded.
The conclusion gives upper bounds only. It does not assert monotone decrease, convergence to zero, attainment of the floors, or lower bounds.

Lean real division is totalized. The run assumptions b!=0 and AxExact=b make the displayed normalized-residual and relative-forward denominators mathematically positive, but this positivity is inherited from bundled data rather than restated in the target.
The premise lambda<1 makes 1-lambda positive in the envelope denominators; D020 itself does not internally include this premise.
Detailed Arnoldi, modified Gram-Schmidt, least-squares, and correction assumptions affect admissibility through each restart certificate but do not appear explicitly in the final inequalities.
ambiguities: The constructor type D033 for LocalDef024 ends with literal ellipses. Consequently, the full set of assumptions and fields in each restarted one-step certificate cannot be recovered from the supplied dossier.

D001 and D002 identify the target-relevant one-step components only by projection position and result type. Their use as modular accuracy and a theorem-record is structurally clear, but the omitted tail of D033 prevents a complete mathematical reconstruction of how those components are produced.
